title: BRL-CAD current DXF converter profile and security gate
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source review and plan update
scope: Refresh BRL-CAD DXF import/output capability from current project manuals
Recheck the open POLYFACE index-safety report and proposed patch status
Map the peer route to existing local PFACE fast validation
Refine optional peer admission without changing routine validation cadence

sources.observation: The manual bounds dxf-g input to ASCII DXF as described by AutoCAD 2006 manuals and lists selected explicit entities and classic 3D POLYLINE, polygon-mesh, and polyface subtypes. It describes layer aggregation, scale, and vertex merge tolerance. The listed profile does not establish Binary DXF, MESH/AcDbSubDMesh, 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY, surfaces, DWG, ACIS/AcDs, or raw-document preservation.

The inverse converter tessellates regions into triangles and writes 3DFACE by default or POLYFACE MESH with an option. It exposes unit, chord, normal, and distance tolerances, so it is not a typed DXF entity-preserving writer route.

Issue #228 reports a full-path heap out-of-bounds read from attacker-controlled POLYFACE face indices in dxf-g. PR #245 remains open/unmerged. Its proposed checks require review against legal negative signed indices and zero termination; neither report nor patch description is a libdxfrw defect or a verified fix.

sources.project: Local libdxfrw POLYFACE validator and generated test owner
sources.observation: The existing validator checks signed one-based face references against the completed coordinate pool and the existing generated ASCII/Binary test owner covers legal visibility signs, zero termination, malformed range controls, extreme negative magnitude, transactional refusal, and a following-entity sentinel. No new vector is justified by this peer report alone.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-37/7V: reuse the existing signed PFACE index and completed-pool fast owner
PAR-07/S8: classify BRL-CAD only as an optional ASCII explicit-geometry consumer
Peer admission: require a pinned safe revision and a source-audited actual import path before execution
assessment.planImpact: The current manuals correct the optional BRL-CAD peer profile: ASCII explicit-entity geometry input only, with a triangulating/faceting inverse writer. The open peer safety issue and unmerged proposed patch prevent treating it as a safe hostile-input comparator. If no pinned safe revision is available at the composed checkpoint, record NOT_RUN/SECURITY_GATE_UNMET and self-unblock to local work. No local test duplication or new support claim is warranted.

method.limitations: Current project manuals and public issue/PR pages were reviewed; no BRL-CAD binary was built or run and no source patch was applied. The issue and proposed fix remain peer reports, not proof of behavior in a specific local artifact. No independent geometric differential, DWG/DXF support qualification, or native CAD result was obtained.
